272:t_112:2.en:
$$シモン$$
(Whatever you do is useless! No matter how much fear you inflict, I'll... punch through it and keep going!)

272:t_113:0.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
(I'm sorry, $$キタン$$... I couldn't properly answer your feelings...)

272:t_113:1.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
(But I won't let this regret crush me... If I did, you'd only laugh at me...!)

272:t_113:2.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
(So I'll fight... as long as I'm alive!)

272:t_114:0.en:
$$ギミー$$
(I-I'm scared... So scared...! This is... just like being brought before the priest in $$アダイ村$$...)

272:t_114:1.en:
$$ギミー$$
(But we... left $$アダイ村$$ and came this far...! We... have to keep moving forward and fight!)

272:t_115:0.en:
$$ダリー$$
(Humans had to live underground... That was the rule the priest laid down... Something I couldn't do anything about on my own...)

272:t_115:1.en:
$$ダリー$$
(But I broke through that and kept living...! So I won't lose...! I don't want to lose!)

272:t_116:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
($$キミコ$$, $$ユング#pilot$$, $$コーチ$$, Big Sis... I won't see you again...)

272:t_116:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(But I'll fight...! I have things to protect... and a flame burning in my heart!)

272:t_116:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(I won't lose to loneliness, regret or fear! $$ガンバスター$$ is invincible when it becomes a flame!)

272:t_117:1.en:
$$葵$$
(A world where I can't hear my comrades... or my parents... The memories of that time come back, whether I want them to or not...)

272:t_117:3.en:
$$葵$$
「Even greater anger burns inside me! At those who dredged up these memories to break my heart!」

272:t_118:0.en:
$$勝平$$
(Grandpa... Dad... Big Bro... Our battle...)

272:t_118:1.en:
$$勝平$$
(I'm sorry, 《$$浜本$$》... If I'd had more power, I could've saved you...)

272:t_118:2.en:
$$勝平$$
(Dammit! I should've shaken off my weak heart in the fight against 《$$コンピュータードール#keyword$$》!)

272:t_118:3.en:
$$勝平$$
(I won't lose to you... or to myself!)

272:t_119:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
(This is bad... No matter how many times I shake it off, I can only think of the worst ending...)

272:t_119:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
(Was I... this weak...? At this rate...)

272:t_119:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
(...But I can't let her... let $$ノノ$$ see me like this...! I'm... the Big Sis she admires!)

272:t_120:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I-I don't know why, but $$ノノ$$ has memories of those monsters inside her, too...!」

272:t_120:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「They are enemies of $$ノノ$$, $$ノノリリ$$... and humanity!」

272:t_121:0.en:
$$チコ$$
(The sorrow and helplessness of that day are coming back, though I thought I'd locked them deep in my heart...)

272:t_121:1.en:
$$チコ$$
(...Keep your hands off my precious memories...! I'll never forgive you!)

272:t_122:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(...I know, even without you telling me... At this rate... I'll soon sink to being a powerless, ordinary human...)

272:t_122:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(But I'm still a $$トップレス$$ now...! I'll make you pay for looking into my heart!)

272:t_123:0.en:
$$赤木$$
(When I was a kid, all I could do... was cower in fear of the $$ヘテロダイン$$s...)

272:t_123:1.en:
$$赤木$$
(Standing before this thing reminds me of how helpless I was then... But...!)

272:t_123:2.en:
$$赤木$$
(I'm an adult... a salaryman now! So I'll fight...! I can fight!)

272:t_124:0.en:
$$ランド$$
(I remember this feeling... When I saw $$メール$$ die... And when the Boss was swallowed by a $$時空震動$$.)

272:t_124:1.en:
$$ランド$$
(Do these things... mean to make me feel that helplessness again...!? But...!)

272:t_124:2.en:
$$ランド$$
(I won't let that happen! I'm $$ザ・ヒート$$! I'm a man who won't lose to any pain!)

272:t_125:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If you're afraid, fall back. Those who cannot fight...」

272:t_125:4.en:
$n
「I'll overcome the fear inside me...! Just as I always have... and always will...!」

272:t_125:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
(As despair grows, so does hope... So the $$いがみ合う双子$$ live up to their name...)

272:t_126:0.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
(I feel so helpless... It's as if I'm a human forced to confess before a god...)

272:t_126:1.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
(But humans possess infinite possibilities... One day, that power will give them strength that bows to no one...)

272:t_126:2.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
(So I cannot lose to the fundamental calamity...!)

272:t_127:1.en:
$$號$$
(Are they the ones who obstruct $$シンカ$$...!?)

277:t_1:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「...Then you met up with the $$マクロス７船団$$ at the galactic center?」

277:t_1:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「To be precise, we met $$バトル７$$, the flagship of its escort fleet.」

277:t_1:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「The $$マクロス７船団$$ is where Captain $$ガムリン$$ and everyone in $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ belonged, right?」

277:t_1:7.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「That's right. $$バトル７$$'s captain, $$マクシミリアン・ジーナス$$, is my dad.」

277:t_1:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「The $$マクロス７船団$$'s supplies also let us finish repairing my $$ＹＦ－２９$$.」

277:t_1:9.en:
$$タケル$$
「What surprised me was finding $$ブレラ$$ there.」

277:t_1:10.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「After the $$新世時空震動$$ sent me to the galactic center, I shut down my biological functions and drifted until the $$マクロス７船団$$ picked me up.」

277:t_1:11.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Y-you shut down your biological functions...?」

277:t_1:12.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ understands! You're an android, just like $$ノノ$$!」

277:t_1:14.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm disappointed... I thought we'd have another friend like me...」

277:t_1:15.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$... Why don't you cheer $$ノノ$$ up?」

277:t_1:16.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I am a pilot support and awareness interface system. Such actions are not provided for.」

277:t_1:18.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But $$バトル７$$ is a ship that protects the fleet, right? Was it all right for it to act alone?」

277:t_1:19.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$バトル７$$ was going to investigate 《$$プロトカルチャー$$》 ruins on the planet $$ネオ・ラクス$$.」

277:t_1:20.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What are $$ネオ・ラクス$$... and $$プロトカルチャー$$?」

277:t_1:21.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「The $$プロトカルチャー$$ were a race that flourished in our world in the distant past.」

277:t_1:22.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「They spread across the galaxy and are said to have uplifted Earth's humans. But they split into two warring factions and deployed the warrior race 《$$ゼントラーディ$$》.」

277:t_1:23.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「There were $$プロトカルチャー$$ ruins on the planet $$ネオ・ラクス$$.」

277:t_1:24.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「The $$マクロス７船団$$ was also researching the universe's collapse once every 12,000 years, but...」

277:t_1:25.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Since the $$プロトカルチャー$$ flourished hundreds of thousands of years ago, we thought they'd have information on it. So an expedition was formed.」

277:t_1:26.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「There were attacks by $$サイデリアル$$ and $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, too. We went to investigate the ruins in $$バトル７$$'s place.」

277:t_1:28.en:
$$アルト$$
「In those ruins, we encountered the will of the $$プロトカルチャー$$.」

277:t_1:29.en:
$$アルト$$
「He said the universe collapses when the force that seeks to vanish clashes with the force that seeks to exist.」

277:t_1:30.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「And apparently, the force that seeks to vanish creates $$バアル$$ to erase the power of life possessed by living beings.」

277:t_1:31.en:
$$アルト$$
「Even if we overcome the collapse every 12,000 years, the universe's true collapse happens once every 120 million years.」

277:t_1:32.en:
$$甲児$$
「That's almost the same as what Dr. $$早乙女$$ told us...」

277:t_1:33.en:
$$アルト$$
「But once we'd heard that much, a new type of $$バジュラ$$ attacked and destroyed the ruins.」

277:t_1:34.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What do you mean, a new type?」

277:t_1:35.en:
$$アルト$$
「Their bodies are a different color from the $$バジュラ$$ we know. They apparently have some connection to the $$ギャラクシー船団$$.」
